comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Faster requests
themes.text: A request that reads or writes JSON, or builds HTML or text, does less work and allocates less memory. JSON costs the same per byte at every size up to the limits. Every security limit stays as it is. The comparison with PHP, Bun and Go is then measured again.

themes.title: JSON of any size
themes.text: `Core\Json::decodeEach` reads a large JSON document one element at a time, from a file or a request body. `Core\Json::encodeEach` writes one in parts. Memory stays the same however large the document is. Both also read and write JSON Lines.
